description: This file defines the ComponentLoader class which implements Twig's LoaderInterface to load templates based on component IDs within Drupal. It manages template discovery, source retrieval, cache key generation, and freshness checks for component templates.

classes.name: ComponentLoader
classes.description: A class that loads templates using component IDs, implementing Twig's LoaderInterface for integration with Twig templating system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ComponentLoader with a plugin manager and logger.

methods.name: findTemplate
methods.description: Finds the template path for a given component name, throwing an error if not found and $throw is true.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a component template exists based on its name.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the source code of a component template as a Twig Source object.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a component template based on its name and provider.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Checks if a component template and its metadata are up-to-date relative to a given timestamp.
